title: PreMaQ: Predicting Maintainability-Related Quality of LLM-Generated Code Before Generation
title_zh: PreMaQ：在生成前预测大型语言模型所生成代码的维护性相关质量

paragraphs.en: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable of code generation, adopting generated code in software development requires assessing not only its functional correctness but also its maintainability-related quality. If such quality could be estimated before generation, developers could avoid the cost of generating, reviewing, and discarding low-quality code. Although prior work has shown that the functional correctness of the LLM-generated code can be predicted in advance, it remains unclear whether maintainability-related quality is similarly predictable. We introduce Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction (PreMaQ), which predicts the Code Smell Score (CSS) and Maintainability Index (MI) of generated code from the internal representations of LLMs before generation. Our evaluation covers four open-weight LLMs and four Python code generation benchmarks, comprising 2,695 tasks in total. Our results show that predicted CSS and MI consistently correlate with their observed values across all 16 model–benchmark combinations, achieving mean Spearman rank correlations of 0.57 and 0.65, respectively. When used for model selection, PreMaQ achieves 59.5% of the maintainability-related quality improvement attainable by an ideal maintainability-based selector over random selection on tasks for which multiple models generate functionally correct code. Combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings increases this proportion to 60.7%, indicating that the two signals are complementary. These findings suggest that PreMaQ can be used to predict and improve the maintainability-related quality of LLM-generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成方面的能力日益增强，在软件开发中采用生成的代码时，不仅需要评估其功能正确性，还需要评估其与维护性相关的质量。 如果能够在生成前估算出这种质量，开发者就可以避免生成、审查和丢弃低质量代码所带来的成本。 尽管先前的研究已经表明，LLM 生成的代码的功能正确性可以提前预测，但维护性相关的质量是否同样可预测仍不清楚。 我们提出了“生成前维护性相关质量预测”（PreMaQ），该方法在代码生成之前，基于 LLM 的内部表示来预测所生成代码的代码异味分数（CSS）和维护性指数（MI）。 我们的评估涵盖了四个开源大型语言模型和四个 Python 代码生成基准测试，总共包含 2,695 项任务。 我们的结果显示，在所有 16 种模型与基准测试的组合中，预测的 CSS 和 MI 都与实际观测值保持一致的相关性，平均 Spearman 等级相关系数分别为 0.57 和 0.65。 在用于模型选择时，对于多个模型都能生成功能正确代码的任务，PreMaQ 能够带来理想维护性导向选择器相比随机选择所能实现的维护性相关质量提升的 59.5%。 将 PreMaQ 的预测结果与提示词嵌入相结合后，这一比例提升至 60.7%，表明这两种信号具有互补性。 这些发现表明，PreMaQ 可用于预测并提升 LLM 生成代码与维护性相关的质量。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used to generate code, supporting tasks that range from code completion to whole-function generation. However, using such code in real-world development requires developers to inspect it and revise it where necessary. Prior studies report that LLM-generated code may contain functional errors [ 1 ] , security vulnerabilities [ 2 , 3 ] , code smells [ 4 , 5 ] , and maintainability issues [ 6 , 7 ] . Verifying and revising LLM-generated code also imposes additional effort and cognitive load on developers [ 8 ] . Assessing generated code therefore requires looking beyond whether it passes tests and considering maintainability-related quality, such as code smells and structural complexity.

paragraphs.en: Maintainability-related quality is typically assessed by applying static analysis to the code after it has been generated. However, code generation itself incurs computational cost and latency, and the generated code may still be functionally incorrect or difficult to maintain. If such code is discarded after generation and evaluation, both generation and evaluation costs are wasted. To reduce unnecessary code generation, prior work has used internal representations available before or during generation to predict properties of generated code. For example, such internal representations have been used to predict functional correctness [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] and compilability or vulnerabilities [ 12 ] . However, these studies mainly target functional correctness or security, and whether internal representations can predict maintainability-related quality before generation remains unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 可维护性相关的质量通常通过在代码生成后对其执行静态分析来评估。 然而，代码生成本身会产生计算成本和延迟，且生成的代码在功能上可能仍然不正确或难以维护。 如果这类代码在生成和评估后被丢弃，那么生成和评估的成本都将被浪费。 为了减少不必要的代码生成，先前的研究已利用生成前或生成过程中可用的内部表示来预测生成代码的属性。 例如，这类内部表示已被用于预测功能正确性 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 以及可编译性或安全性问题 [ 12 ] 。 然而，这些研究主要关注功能正确性或安全性，而内部表示是否能在生成前预测可维护性相关的质量仍是一个未被探索的问题。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this open question, this study introduces and evaluates Pre-Generation Maintainability-Related Quality Prediction (PreMaQ) , which uses prefill activations to predict maintainability-related quality before code generation. Prefill activations are the internal representations computed while an LLM processes the input prompt. Figure 1 shows the PreMaQ workflow. As the maintainability-related quality to be predicted, we use the following two indicators used in a prior study [ 13 ] : Code Smell Score (CSS) [ 7 , 14 ] and Maintainability Index (MI) [ 15 , 16 ] .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate prediction both within and across benchmarks to examine whether it extends beyond benchmark-specific patterns. As a downstream analysis, we examine the model selection problem of identifying, among multiple models known to generate functionally correct code for a task, the model likely to produce code with the highest maintainability-related quality. paragraphs.en: This section reviews prior work to position our work, and then reports a preliminary study that motivates the need for predicting maintainability-related code quality and selecting models likely to produce maintainable code accordingly.

paragraphs.en: Analysis of LLM Internal Representations. LLM internal representations refer to hidden states or activations computed during prompt processing or token generation. They include the outputs of the attention and MLP modules and the residual stream, computed at each layer for each token position. Because these representations reflect how an LLM processes a given input, prior work has used them to infer properties of the LLM’s behavior and outputs. Azaria and Mitchell [ 17 ] showed that the truthfulness of LLM output can be inferred from internal representations. Zhou et al. [ 18 ] detected jailbreak attacks using a neuron activation coverage metric defined over internal representations.
paragraphs.zh: 对大型语言模型内部表示的分析。 大型语言模型的内部表示指的是在提示处理或标记生成过程中计算出的隐藏状态或激活值。 它们包括注意力和多层感知机模块的输出，以及每一层每个标记位置计算出的残差流。 由于这些表示反映了大型语言模型如何处理特定输入，先前的研究曾利用它们来推断该模型行为和输出的特性。 Azaria 和 Mitchell [17] 指出，可以通过内部表示推断出大型语言模型输出的真实性。Zhou 等人 [18] 则通过一种基于内部表示定义的神经元激活覆盖度指标，检测到了越狱攻击。

paragraphs.en: Prediction of Output Quality. Because generating output with an LLM incurs computational and financial costs, prior work has sought to estimate output quality before it is produced. Some methods predict the output quality of each LLM from the input or previous responses and select a model for the task, and others escalate to a more capable model when adequate quality is not expected [ 19 , 20 ] . For code completion, prior work has predicted reference-based completion similarity from the prompt [ 21 ] . For code generation, internal representations have been used to assess properties of generated code, including functional correctness [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 22 , 23 ] , compilability [ 12 ] , and the presence of vulnerabilities [ 12 , 24 ] . However, the predicted properties are mainly functional correctness or security, and whether maintainability-related quality indicators, such as CSS and MI, can be predicted before generation remains unexplored. This study therefore investigates whether these indicators can be predicted before generation from internal representations.
paragraphs.zh: 输出质量的预测。 由于使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成输出会产生计算和财务成本，先前的研究试图在生成输出之前估算其质量。 一些方法通过输入或先前响应来预测每个 LLM 的输出质量，并为任务选择模型；另一些方法则在预期无法达到足够质量时升级到能力更强的模型 [19, 20]。 在代码补全方面，先前的研究已尝试根据提示词预测基于参考的补全相似度 [21]。 在代码生成方面，研究人员曾利用内部表示来评估生成代码的特性，包括功能正确性 [9, 10, 11, 12, 22, 23]、可编译性 [12] 以及是否存在漏洞 [12, 24]。 然而，预测的特性主要局限于功能正确性或安全性，而诸如 CSS 和 MI 等与维护性相关的质量指标能否在生成前被预测，这一问题尚未得到探索。 因此，本研究旨在探究是否可以通过内部表示在生成前预测这些指标。

paragraphs.en: To motivate predicting maintainability-related quality directly, we set the following Preliminary Question (PQ).

paragraphs.en: To what extent model size or functional correctness can identify the model that generates code with the highest maintainability-related quality.
paragraphs.zh: 模型规模或功能正确性能在多大程度上识别出能够生成可维护性相关质量最高的代码的智能体？

To answer the PQ, we conduct a preliminary study using the same experimental setting as the main study: four local LLMs, four code generation benchmarks, two maintainability-related quality indicators (CSS and MI), and one functional correctness indicator (AvgPassRatio). paragraphs.en: This section describes PreMaQ, our approach for predicting the quality of generated code from prefill activations before generation begins. We first formulate the problem and then describe the internal representations used as features, the quality indicators to be predicted, and the predictor architecture.

sents.en: This section describes PreMaQ, our approach for predicting the quality of generated code from prefill activations before generation begins.

paragraphs.en: PreMaQ predicts the maintainability-related quality of the code that an LLM will generate, using the internal representations computed while the LLM processes the input prompt. Hereafter, we refer to these representations as prefill activations . Let 𝒟 \mathcal{D} be a set of input prompts in a code generation benchmark, and let f f be an LLM that generates code. For a prompt x ∈ 𝒟 x\in\mathcal{D} , we denote the code generated by f f as f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) . For a quality indicator q q , the quality of this generated code is denoted by q ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( x ) ) q(f(x)) . The code quality predictor g f , q 𝒟 g^{\mathcal{D}}_{f,q} takes as input the feature vector z f ​ ( x ) z_{f}(x) derived from the prefill activations obtained by forwarding x x through f f , and predicts the value of the quality indicator q ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( x ) ) q(f(x)) . Because z f ​ ( x ) z_{f}(x) can be obtained with only one forward pass, the quality can be estimated without paying the cost of code generation. paragraphs.en: This section presents the research questions, subject models and benchmarks, data splits, predictor training and evaluation settings for RQ1, model selection procedure and evaluation for RQ2, and implementation details.

paragraphs.en: We formulate the following research questions to examine prediction performance and its application to model selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出以下研究问题，以考察预测性能及其在模型选择中的应用。

paragraphs.en: How well does PreMaQ predict the maintainability-related quality of generated code?
paragraphs.zh: PreMaQ 对生成代码的可维护性相关质量预测效果如何？

paragraphs.en: How does PreMaQ-based model selection compare with selection without internal representations in terms of maintainability-related quality?
paragraphs.zh: 与不使用内部表示的选择方法相比，基于 PreMaQ 的模型选择在可维护性相关的质量方面表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ1 evaluates PreMaQ’s prediction performance within and across benchmarks for each LLM–benchmark combination, using functional correctness as a comparison target and comparing four activation sources. RQ2 evaluates whether PreMaQ-based model selection improves maintainability-related quality over strategies without internal representations. To isolate maintainability-related quality, we restrict the candidates for each task to models known to generate functionally correct code. This setting with known functionally correct candidates builds on prior work on pre-generation prediction of functional correctness [ 9 , 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 针对每种 LLM–基准组合，在单个基准和跨基准的范围内评估 PreMaQ 的预测性能，以功能正确性作为比较目标，并对比四种激活源。 RQ2 评估基于 PreMaQ 的模型选择是否能在可维护性相关的质量方面优于不使用内部表示的策略。 为了单独考察与可维护性相关的质量，我们将每个任务的候选模型限制为已知能够生成功能正确代码的模型。 这种使用已知功能正确的候选模型的设置，建立在了先前关于功能正确性预生成预测的研究基础之上 [ 9 , 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The prediction targets, AvgPassRatio, CSS, and MI, are all learned as regression targets, and the loss function is mean squared error (MSE). We use MSE as the training objective because it is a standard smooth loss for continuous regression. During training, we normalize all prediction targets to the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . For the 5-fold cross validation, we fix the random seed for fold assignment and obtain out-of-fold predictions so that every task is included in the evaluation data exactly once. These settings are shared across all combinations of LLM, benchmark, prediction target, and input feature. Only the input features and labels differ across combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 预测目标 AvgPassRatio、CSS 和 MI 均被学习为回归目标，其损失函数为均方误差（MSE）。 我们将 MSE 用作训练目标，因为它是连续回归的标准平滑损失函数。 在训练过程中，我们将所有预测目标归一化到区间 [0, 1]。 对于 5 折交叉验证，我们固定随机种子以分配折次，并获取折外预测结果，从而确保每个任务在评估数据中恰好出现一次。 这些设置在 LLM、基准测试、预测目标和输入特征的所有组合中均保持一致。 仅输入特征和标签在不同组合之间存在差异。

This strategy follows prior work in predicting output quality from prompt-derived information [ 21 , 20 ] .

paragraphs.en: In our environment, training one predictor took approximately 4 to 33 seconds, depending on the feature dimensionality and the number of tasks. Quality prediction with a trained predictor took less than 0.4 ms per task. The additional computation required for quality prediction is only one forward pass for obtaining prefill activations and the predictor inference, making it much faster than generating code and measuring its quality afterward.

paragraphs.en: PreMaQ-based model selection improves MRQS over the evaluated baselines. PreMaQ outperforms Random, Average-best, and prompt embedding, achieving a relative gain of 59.5 59.5 % compared with 0.0 0.0 %, 17.2 17.2 %, and 49.6 49.6 %, respectively. PreMaQ-based model selection improves the maintainability-related quality of generated code without sacrificing functional correctness because every candidate model in the target tasks generates functionally correct code. The performance of prompt embedding indicates that the task prompt itself can predict maintainability-related quality to some extent. Notably, combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings achieves higher selection performance ( 60.7 60.7 %) than either method alone.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 PreMaQ 的模型选择方法在 MRQS 方面优于所评估的基线方法。 PreMaQ 的表现优于随机选择、平均最佳和提示嵌入方法，与后者的相对增益分别为 59.5%、17.2% 和 49.6%。 基于 PreMaQ 的模型选择方法能够提升生成代码在可维护性方面的质量，同时不会牺牲功能正确性，因为目标任务中的每个候选模型都能生成功能正确的代码。 提示嵌入的表现表明，任务提示本身能够在一定程度上预测与可维护性相关的代码质量。 值得注意的是，结合 PreMaQ 和提示嵌入的预测结果，其选择性能（60.7%）高于单独使用任一方法的结果。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 shows that PreMaQ can improve the maintainability-related quality achieved by model selection in a setting with known functionally correct candidates. This section discusses how maintainability-aware model selection could support developers who use LLMs for code generation. paragraphs.en: Integration. Maintainability-related quality prediction can be integrated with functional-correctness prediction. Prior work [ 9 , 10 ] has used pre-generation predictions of functional correctness to select a model. These activation-based routing methods provide a direct integration point with our approach. For example, Lugoloobi et al. [ 9 ] use prefill activations to predict the probability that each candidate model will solve a task and select a model based on the predicted probability and inference cost. Our predictions of maintainability-related quality can be incorporated into this routing process as an additional selection criterion. A routing policy could either filter candidates by predicted correctness before considering predicted maintainability-related quality and inference cost, or jointly combine all three criteria according to developer priorities. Both designs move beyond the RQ2 setting with known functionally correct candidates by using predicted correctness. This additional prediction of maintainability-related quality does not require another LLM forward pass. The router already performs a prompt forward pass for correctness prediction, so our prediction requires only capturing the necessary internal representations and running the maintainability-related quality predictors. The resulting runtime overhead is sufficiently low for practical use, as discussed in the next subsection.
paragraphs.zh: 集成。 可维护性相关的品质预测可以与功能正确性预测相集成。 先前的工作 [ 9 , 10 ] 已使用功能正确性的预生成预测来选择模型。 这些基于激活的路由方法为我们的方法提供了直接的集成点。 例如，Lugoloobi 等人 [ 9 ] 使用预填充激活来预测每个候选模型解决任务的可能性，并根据预测概率和推理成本选择模型。 我们对可维护性相关品质的预测可以作为额外的选择标准纳入此路由过程。 路由策略既可以在考虑预测的可维护性相关品质和推理成本之前，根据预测的正确性筛选候选模型，也可以根据开发人员的优先级将这三个标准联合起来。 这两种设计都通过使用预测的正确性，超越了已知功能正确的候选者这一 RQ2 设定。 这种对可维护性相关品质的额外预测不需要再次执行 LLM 的前向传播。 路由器已经为正确性预测执行了提示前向传播，因此我们的预测只需捕获必要的内部表示并运行可维护性相关品质预测器。 如下一小节所讨论的，由此产生的运行时开销足够低，适合实际使用。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table VII , in a standalone pipeline after model loading, the dominant per-task runtime cost is the prompt forward pass with internal representation capture, which takes 145.7 145.7 ms on average. paragraphs.en: Guidance. PreMaQ is best used alongside prompt embedding when white-box access is available. In RQ2, combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings achieves the best selection performance, with a relative gain of 60.7 60.7 %. Thus, when internal activations are accessible, PreMaQ should be used as an additional signal alongside prompt-embedding predictions. For API-only models without access to internal activations, prompt embeddings provide a black-box alternative, which achieves a relative gain of 49.6 49.6 % in our evaluation. Our combination uses a simple average of the two predictions; weighted or learned combinations are left for future work.

paragraphs.en: External validity. The results of this study are based on four local models and four Python code generation benchmarks. To improve generalizability, we included both general-purpose and code-specialized models, evaluated benchmarks with different levels of complexity, and further conducted cross-benchmark evaluation. However, it remains untested whether the results generalize to larger models, different model families, or programming languages other than Python. The prompt embedding baseline uses only all-MiniLM-L6-v2, and using a different embedding model may change the comparison results.

paragraphs.en: This study proposed PreMaQ, which predicts the maintainability-related quality of LLM-generated code from prefill activations, and evaluated its use in model selection. Using four open-weight LLMs and four Python code generation benchmarks, we found that predictions of CSS and MI are correlated with their observed values in all within-benchmark model–benchmark combinations. Prediction also generalizes across benchmarks for most combinations, more consistently for MI than for CSS. In the RQ2 setting with known functionally correct candidates, PreMaQ-based model selection outperforms the evaluated strategies without internal representations, while combining predictions from PreMaQ and prompt embeddings achieves the best selection performance.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究提出了 PreMaQ，该方法可根据预填充激活值预测 LLM 生成代码的与维护性相关的质量，并评估了其在模型选择中的应用。 通过四款开放权重的 LLM 和四个 Python 代码生成基准测试，我们发现 CSS 和 MI 的预测值与所有基准测试内部模型-基准测试组合中观测到的值存在相关性。 对于大多数组合而言，预测结果在不同基准测试之间也具备泛化能力，其中 MI 的一致性优于 CSS。 在已知功能正确的候选模型的 RQ2 设置中，基于 PreMaQ 的模型选择方法的表现优于未使用内部表示的评估策略，而结合 PreMaQ 的预测与提示嵌入则实现了最佳的选择性能。

paragraphs.en: These findings suggest that developers could consider predicted maintainability-related quality alongside predicted functional correctness and inference cost when selecting a model before code generation. For researchers, prior work and our findings motivate future investigation into which additional generated-code properties can be predicted from internal representations. Such investigation could reveal the broader potential of internal representations as pre-generation signals for software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现表明，在代码生成前选择模型时，开发者可以考虑预测的与维护性相关的质量，以及预测的功能正确性和推理成本。 对于研究人员而言，先前的工作和我们的发现为未来研究哪些额外的生成代码属性可以从内部表示中预测出来提供了动力。 此类研究可能揭示内部表示作为软件工程预生成信号的更广泛潜力。
